statements.markdown: **Theorem 2.11 (One-sidedness).** *Non-membership of $1/2$ in $\mathcal A$ has an effectively checkable finite-certificate formulation, hence a $\Sigma^0_1$ formulation. Membership has the complementary $\Pi^0_1$ formulation. Survival through a tested finite depth alone does not establish membership; a uniform theorem or inductive invariant could. The arithmetical-hierarchy form by itself proves neither undecidability nor the absence of finite proofs.*
